name: Botlierskop Day Visitors & Spekbos Restaurant
description_short: Game reserve restaurant serving traditional South African dishes with sweeping views of wildlife and wilderness.
description_long:
Spekbos Restaurant at Botlierskop offers a unique dining experience where you can enjoy a hearty meal while watching game roam the surrounding reserve. The setting alone makes it worth the visit – wide-open views across the bushveld with the Outeniqua Mountains as backdrop.

The menu leans into traditional South African fare with generous portions that fuel a day of game drives and nature walks. Think bobotie, potjiekos, and flame-grilled meats alongside lighter options for those preferring something fresh. The restaurant caters well to families, with space for kids to move around and an atmosphere that's relaxed rather than formal.

Located just outside Mossel Bay, Botlierskop makes for an excellent stop if you're combining a safari experience with the coastal attractions of the Garden Route. Day visitors are welcome, and the restaurant serves as a comfortable base between activities on the reserve.
